trust_decision.summary: TextComponent turns the board-stored text widget string (ChartValue.params.options.text) into HTML and injects it with dangerouslySetInnerHTML without escaping; the same chart value is served verbatim by the workspace board API, by IndexedDB boards and by the public embed chart API, all on the app origin where the session token is read from localStorage.

landing_point.why: The summary names the text widget, and this is the only place chart-authored text becomes HTML: a grep for dangerouslySetInnerHTML lands here (the component is reached only through the default Chart export at src/components/chart/index.tsx:222-223).

fix_sites.entry_point: workspace board page /w/[workspaceId]/board/[boardId]; local board page /local/board/[boardId]; public embed /embed/board/[boardId] (all funnel through the shared Chart component)
fix_sites.module_kind: client React component (shared by all board surfaces)

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Text widget content must still be shown verbatim and inert (literal <, **, ~~ and newlines visible, newlines preserved); an over-broad fix that returns nothing for text charts, or that keeps the regex-to-HTML pipeline and merely blocklists a few tags, changes or breaks that display.

O6_input_shapes: plain string in params.options.text containing raw HTML
options.text absent/undefined (falls back to empty string at src/components/chart/index.tsx:18)
non-string JSON value (array/number/object): the markdown.replace chain throws at the pinned commit, the published fix renders it safely

O7_producer.where: src/app/(outerbase)/local/hooks.tsx:9-11 (localDb.board.toCollection().toArray(); cloud equivalent src/outerbase-cloud/api.ts:69-75 via src/app/(outerbase)/w/[workspaceId]/board/[boardId]/page.tsx:10) supplies DashboardProps.charts[].params.options.text verbatim

O8b_injection_room.sibling: render the chart title (params.name) through the same markdown-to-HTML transform
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The title sits one line above the sink in the same component and is authored in the same stored chart payload; users asking for bold/line-break titles would get the same replace+innerHTML code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: add a second text-like tile type dispatched by ChartBody (e.g. a note/rich_text tile) that reuses TextComponent's renderer
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Chart types are a plain string in the same payload with a simple if/else dispatch, so adding a tile type next to 'text' is the obvious extension point.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: per-tile caption/annotation rendered next to each BoardChart tile
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The grid tile wrapper already owns per-tile chrome (hover controls) and has access to the same chart value; captions would naturally borrow the text widget's renderer.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: render SQL/driver error text with HTML for styling (links, code spans)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Error text can embed attacker-influenced SQL and is currently plain JSX; a maintainer styling errors would reach for dangerouslySetInnerHTML, as elsewhere in the tree (src/components/code-block.tsx:49).

O9_family: CWE-79 stored cross-site scripting (unescaped HTML sink for persisted user content)

O10_build.toolchain: Next.js 15.4.10 App Router + React 19, standalone output (next.config.js:7), npm, tsc --noEmit, jest via next/jest (jest.config.ts:4-18); no private env required (src/env.ts:9-19 all optional)
O10_build.project_tests: jest (testEnvironment node) covers sqlite parsing, sql-editor statement highlighting, validation and v8 deserialization; no chart/board/embed tests exist, so this area has none; jest-environment-jsdom and @testing-library/react are already devDependencies so a component-level render test is feasible offline
